scripts.build: node scripts/clean-dist.cjs && tsc && npm run typecheck:strict
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run register:compiled && node dist/index.js
scripts.register: npm run build && npm run register:compiled
scripts.native:build: napi build --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --package rascal-native --release --platform --output-dir native --js rascal-native.js --dts rascal-native.d.ts
scripts.benchmark:text: npm run build && npm run native:build && node dist/scripts/benchmark-text-normalizer.js
